description: Dawson’s fascination with Jen forces him and Joey to confront feelings their childhood friendship can no longer contain, while Pacey’s own choices and the Leery family’s problems complicate an already volatile year in Capeside.

s01e01.description: Dawson becomes infatuated with newcomer Jen while Joey struggles with jealousy, and Pacey discovers that the older woman he likes is his new teacher.

s01e02.description: Dawson grows jealous when Jen attends a school dance with another boy, while Joey confronts Gale about her affair and Pacey continues provoking Tamara.

s01e03.description: Dawson tries to engineer the perfect first kiss with Jen, Joey is swept up by a wealthy stranger, and Pacey pushes his relationship with Tamara further.

s01e04.description: Dawson learns about his mother’s affair and that Joey already knew, while Jen reveals painful parts of her past and Pacey and Tamara continue seeing each other.

s01e05.description: A hurricane traps the group together at the Leery home, where Mitch learns the truth about Gale’s affair and several strained relationships finally erupt.

s01e06.description: Rumors about Tamara and Pacey threaten both of them, while Joey and Jen unexpectedly work together when Bessie goes into labor at the Leery house.

s01e07.description: Dawson, Joey, Pacey and Jen spend a Saturday in detention, where rivalries flare and Joey finally reveals some of the hurt behind her hostility toward Jen.

s01e08.description: Jen’s former boyfriend arrives from New York and unsettles Dawson, while a beach party and Joey’s drinking bring hidden feelings to the surface.

s01e09.description: Billy takes Dawson and Pacey on a reckless night out, while Joey becomes the target of a cruel rumor at school and Jen helps her retaliate.

s01e10.description: Dawson attempts a double date to prove he can remain friends with Jen, while a school project draws Pacey and Joey unexpectedly closer together.

s01e11.description: Dawson’s Friday-the-13th prank coincides with reports of a real serial killer nearby, and increasingly disturbing messages make Jen fear she is genuinely being targeted.

s01e12.description: Joey and Pacey enter a local beauty contest for very different reasons, while Jen begins regretting the way her relationship with Dawson ended.

s01e13.description: Joey considers leaving Capeside for France and visits her imprisoned father, while Dawson finally confronts his feelings for her and Jen suffers a family loss.
